english.title: Aid / abet theft from the person of another
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled and procured, another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to steal **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),

(A)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..),]_
(B)_[of a value unknown,]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and 7 of the Theft Act 1968 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and / or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:NoneOn the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
